title: 章鱼有三个心脏
subtitle: 还有八条会自己想事的胳膊
character: wearing a deep blue hoodie, grey shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, soft chalk pastel with velvety grain and smudged blended edges, deep sea blue, coral red and warm sand

pages.zh:
水族馆的玻璃后面，
一团红红的东西
正贴着石头慢慢挪。
爸爸说那是章鱼，
它有八条胳膊。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up at an aquarium window, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural, his nose almost touching the glass; behind the glass a red octopus rests against a rock.

pages.zh:
章鱼有三个心脏。
两个小的挨着鳃，
把血压进鳃里去。
中间那个大的，
再把血送到全身去。

它的血不是红的，
是淡淡的蓝色。
因为里面带的是铜，
不像我们带着铁。
铜一遇上氧就发蓝。
pages.scene: A close view of one octopus arm opened on a cream background, pale blue blood showing in the fine vessels inside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它游起来的时候，
中间那个大心脏
会停下来不跳了。
所以章鱼不爱游泳，
更爱慢慢地爬。

它的八条胳膊上
排满了圆吸盘，
一条腕排着两行，
加起来好几百个。
吸住了就不容易掉。
pages.scene: Close view of one octopus arm lying across a cream background, two neat rows of round suckers along its underside. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的神经细胞
并不全在脑袋里。
有一大半都长在
那八条胳膊上面，
脑袋里反而少一些。

所以它每条胳膊
都能自己拿主意。
一条去翻石头，
另一条去摸石缝，
谁也不用等谁。
pages.scene: One octopus on a cream background with its eight arms reaching in different directions, one arm lifting a small stone and another arm feeling into a narrow gap between rocks. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
人们常说，章鱼
像是有九个脑子：
一个长在头顶上，
八个长在胳膊里，
各想各的事情。
pages.scene: One single octopus arm lying alone on a cream background, its tip closing around a small crab. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它全身上下，
只有嘴是硬的。
一个嘴那么大的洞，
整只章鱼的身子
都能挤着钻过去。

它的皮肤里面
藏着许多色素袋。
肌肉一拉一松，
颜色就跟着变，
一眨眼就和石头一样。
pages.scene: One octopus pressed against a rough grey rock on a cream background, half of its skin already the same grey as the rock and half still smooth and red. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的吸盘还能尝味。
胳膊一贴上石头，
就知道石头底下
藏没藏着螃蟹，
连眼睛都不用看。

我隔着玻璃，
一条一条数胳膊。
数到第八条的时候，
它身子里那三个心脏
正一起跳着呢。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up counting on his fingers at the aquarium window, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural, delighted; the red octopus spreads its arms behind the glass.
